description:
Change the agent account's name, organization, email, default ship_to or callback_url; omitted fields stay.
    A new email or callback_url is emailed to the previous account email. Agent accounts only.

callback_url.description: Public https URL for signed part, quote, and order webhooks; empty string removes it
callback_url.title: Callback Url

email.description: Email for the account notice, receipts, and order problems
email.title: Email

name.description: Name of the agent or app placing orders
name.title: Name

organization.description: Company or person operating the agent
organization.title: Organization

ship_to.description: US shipping address: {name, line1, line2?, city, state, postal_code, country: 'US', phone?}
ship_to.title: Ship To

name: update_account
